description: Sansec tracks a Magento skimmer campaign that infected 953 stores, using five domains, bot filtering and malicious code hidden in CMS blocks. title: Magento Campaign Infects 953 Online Stores Across Five Domains

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Dutch police arrest two men over AI-voiced bank fraud that allegedly used a fake app to steal card data from 170 victims, causing €380,000 in losses. Rotterdam police have arrested two men over a new type of bank fraud that used AI-generated phone calls, a fake banking app, and NFC technology to steal bank card […]
title: AI-Generated Fake Bank Calls and NFC App Enabled €380,000 Fraud, Dutch Police Say

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: uCreater is Android spyware disguised as trusted apps, stealing credentials, messages and wallet data through a rentable platform. uCreater is a rentable Android spyware platform that hides inside repackaged legitimate apps, targeting messaging services and mobile wallets. Its YingGai framework can intercept one-time passwords, steal account and chat data, collect contacts, manipulate sessions and spoof […]
title: Researchers Uncover Rentable Android Spyware uCreater Targeting WeChat and Telegram

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cyfirma links PHP2Shell scans of 216 vulnerable hosts to a suspected North Korean campaign using AI to rank public exploits. title: PHP2Shell: Suspected North Korean campaign targets 216 vulnerable PHP hosts
